context: Hina paints a picture for Sho.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Sho! You actually drew a picture!
lines.style: Bright, proud opening on Sho's name. High child's voice, genuinely delighted. Warm and sincere without performance. Emphasis lands naturally on the accomplishment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わあ、本当、嬉しい、本当に。
lines.en: Wow — I'm really happy. I really am.
lines.style: Soft, small voice with genuine surprise and warmth. Six-year-old wonder. The repetition feels authentic, not sung. Tender underneath, audible smile.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: You're so kind, my friend. Really.
lines.style: High, warm recognition. Child's sincerity without performance. Soft emphasis on the friendship. Gentle closing, like she's said something important and knows it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, small voice. Genuine realization. No brightness here — just steady, warm certainty. The word 'treasure' lands softly. Tender and present.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: This is really fun. It really is.
lines.style: High child voice returning to brightness, but deeper now. Warm closing note. Contentment and joy held together. Soft trailing close, like settling into the moment.
